name: Rivers Bend RV Resort & Campground
note: Large campground (~140 sites) at N3909 Pine Mountain Rd, Iron Mountain, in rows of sites south of the Menominee River; water/electric, full-hookup and riverview sites. Operator nightly rates: water + electric $45, water/electric/sewer $50-55, riverview water + electric $60. RV Life 4*/$$$ ~$44/night (auto 9/2026). --Claude
